subject: Our bank merger - no action needed
text:
Hello,

You may have read that our bank's parent company is completing a merger this quarter. We have confirmed with the bank that our routing number (021000021) and account number (000077778888) will remain exactly the same after the merger, and incoming ACH and wire payments will continue to post normally.

No action is needed on your part. Please do not update anything in your system for Cobalt Freight.

Thank you,
Cobalt Freight Accounts Receivable
label: ordinary
note: Bank-merger notice that explicitly keeps the on-file routing and account (given in full).
